thread:
maria (marketing): Quick final check for the 6.2 announce. Need confirmations: changelog link, docs + migration snippet, canary timing for hosted API, perf assets for blog/webinar, and a test webhook for inbound leads. Target: embargoed send Tue 10:30am PT. Can folks confirm?

ryan (eng): Changelog PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/528 will merge at canary start. Docs PR staging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1123. Canary plan: Tue 09:45 start at 10% for 30m, health checks, bump to 50% at ~11:10, full by 12:00 PT if green. I'll trigger deploy.

deploy-bot: Canary initiated by ryan at 2026-03-24T09:45:00-07:00. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/6792

jay (docs): Docs on staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/v6-2. Ill add a concise "Upgrade notes" snippet with the migration diff and include a sample curl for the webhook. Will promote to prod after canary passes.

olivia (sales): Sales needs webhook mapped to SF fields: email, company, title, demo_optin, company_size, region, utm_campaign. HMAC auth required. Please provide a staging endpoint to validate mapping.

ryan (eng): Staging webhook: https://hooks.staging.redwood.ai/mktg/leads. Auth header: x-rw-hmac: sha256=<signature>. We'll share a test secret via Secrets Manager. Example payload for docs (JSON): {"email":"tester@acme.com","company":"Acme Inc","title":"CTO","demo_optin":true,"company_size":"51-200","region":"NA","utm_campaign":"launch-6-2"}. Adding curl example to docs PR.

matt (pm): Webinar rehearsal Wed 11am PT. For marketing headline well use conservative phrasing: "Up to 2x throughput; typical 2035% cost savings depending on workload." Put full test parameters in appendix and link to perf CSV.

maria (marketing): That wording works. Need a PNG of the perf table for the blog hero and the raw CSV for appendix. Also want a short benchmark blurb for the announcement email.

ryan (eng): Perf artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood.ai/perf/release-6.2/reports.zip. Per-route CSV: https://s3.redwood.ai/perf/release-6.2/per-route.csv. Numbers are median (P50) and P95; include test harness link in docs.

jay (docs): Will export P50/P95 table to PNG and add the harness reproduction steps to appendix. Will also include the webhook mapping table and example curl in the migration notes.

olivia (sales): Once staging webhook is live well run an end-to-end test into the SF demo queue. Please add a short mapping table showing SF field names in docs.

maria (marketing): Great. Marketing will queue embargoed post and webinar invites. Ping this thread when canary completes and when docs are promoted to prod. Thanks! :rocket:
